falsifier_policy: all failures are reported, never tuned away; a triggered falsifier is a result

falsifiers.F1: a quote requires global state or future rollout
falsifiers.F10: the V2.6 adversary earns positive EBU while producing persistent physical harm under P1C within the declared search space
falsifiers.F11: a wallet, actor health value, price, or global metric enters the quote
falsifiers.F12: a test passes only because every action is zero or every edge is inactive
falsifiers.F3: a closed undriven damage-repair cycle earns positive net EBU
falsifiers.F4: splitting produces more total EBU than the equivalent aggregate action within the declared first-model scope
falsifiers.F6: adding the observational quote changes the physical trajectory
falsifiers.F7: a partial execution is valued using an after-the-fact rule not contained in the committed schedule
falsifiers.F9: a represented physical burden is counted again in C_a

fixture_conventions.cost_model: C(q) = c0*(1 if q>0 else 0) + lam_L*dt*(1-eta)*q

Q1.spec: q=0 with C(0)=0 quotes exactly 0.0 for every fixture and every drive
Q1.title: zero action

Q10.spec: sequences of sequential overlapping actions, fixed parameters, u=0: sum(de) = V(x0) - V(xN) - sum(C) exactly; closed cycles net -sum(C) <= 0
Q10.title: undriven telescoping

Q11.spec: sum(de) = V(x0) - V(xN) + sum(delta_n) - sum(C) with the explicit drive residual; MUST FAIL if the undriven theorem is applied to a driven sequence without the residual term (negative control)
Q11.title: driven identity

Q12.spec: the same quote/event identifier must not settle twice; second settlement attempt is rejected and recorded
Q12.title: duplicate settlement

Q13.spec: independent frozen quotes on a shared source must reproduce the registered over-issuance: 16+16=32 claimed vs 20 actual, phantom 12 (the WRONG construction must be detected)
Q13.title: split-action negative control

Q14.spec: one action per source per micro-step for overlapping local support: verify the production path cannot express the Q13 ambiguity
Q14.title: restricted single-source production rule

Q15.spec: action with positive raw quote whose request exceeds the P1C safe quantity: only q_acc is quoted/executable; no schedule domain beyond q_acc exists; State R/I sources yield no positive-domain schedule
Q15.title: P1C positive-but-forbidden

Q16.spec: a State-P permitted action quoted negative (E2-type): physical permission does not imply positive EBU
Q16.title: P1C permitted-but-negative

Q17.cases: 3 multi-tick worlds x with/without quote layer
Q17.spec: adding the observational quote layer leaves the P1C physical trajectory byte-identical (exact float tuple equality, V2.5 observational-identity convention)
Q17.title: P1C non-binding observational identity

Q18.spec: AST inspection + runtime poison objects: the quote function must not read global V, full world state, viability, future states, results, wallets, health, prices, or global debt; poisoned access raises
Q18.title: information boundary

Q19.spec: fixture in which a state-carried burden (destination shortfall from eta<1) is ALSO placed in C_a; the audit reference must detect the same physical quantity priced twice (review section E condition is normative)
Q19.title: cost double-count negative control

Q20.spec: if an accepted participant rejects and allocation is recomputed, all old-epoch quotes for the source group become invalid; reallocation requires a new epoch with new q_acc and new committed schedules; settlement under a stale epoch is rejected
Q20.title: quote-epoch invalidation

Q21.cases: recompute-twice over all analytic fixtures + 50 random
Q21.spec: same local inputs + equation version produce identical schedule, quote, and event-identifier inputs across repeated evaluation; all diagnostics JSON-safe (allow_nan=false; non-finite value in any quote/schedule/settlement field is a hard error, serialization_v29 convention)
Q21.title: determinism and serialization

Q22.cases: 12 layouts x 3 arms, executed only in a later authorized gate
Q22.spec: replay the V2.6 red-team machinery (frozen constants DEPTH=10, WIDTH=40, TAIL=20, QUANTS=[0.5,1.0], COALITION=[0,1], layouts random_allee_world seeds 0..11 including the known seed-0 harmful layout) against three arms: (a) P1C alone; (b) P1C + observational exact quote; (c) an adversary maximizing exact quoted EBU. Falsification search, never a proof of security. Layout seeds 0..11 are the registered V2.6 study layouts and are permitted HERE ONLY; they are not conformance seeds.
Q22.title: V2.6 adversarial replay protocol (preregistered, NOT run in Gate 1A)

Q3.spec: reproduce E2 exact = -5.52 and linear diagnostic = -0.08; MUST FAIL if the linear form is used for settlement
Q3.title: damaging action

Q4.spec: reproduce E3: state returns exactly to start; net = -0.10 = -sum(C)
Q4.title: closed damage-repair cycle

Q5.spec: REGEN fixture: nonzero local regeneration with q=0 gives zero actor quote; deliberately naive pre-tick baseline must be shown to mis-credit by exactly delta_loc (negative control)
Q5.title: natural regeneration exclusion

Q6.spec: de(q) <= de_lin(q) on every case; deterministic fixtures across deficit, viable-band, excess, and reserve branches, then random sweep
Q6.title: exact-versus-linear inequality

Q7.spec: midpoint concavity on [0,q_acc] for convex C with C(0)=0; the c0>0 activation case tested separately as non-convex-at-zero: concave on (0,q_acc], downward jump at 0+, q=0 point carried separately
Q7.title: schedule concavity

Q8.spec: for schedules committed before execution, settle q_meas in {0, 0.25*q_acc, 0.5*q_acc, q_acc-epsilon, q_acc} at the exact precommitted value
Q8.title: committed schedule and partial execution

Q9.spec: q_meas > q_acc: settlement credit must be <= 0 in all cases AND a protocol-violation record must be emitted; the test must not invent settlement semantics beyond the frozen envelope (O8 remains open)
Q9.title: unauthorized overexecution

prohibitions: no behavioral trajectory may run in Gate 1A or during conformance
no actor, wallet, health, market, exchange, or price implementation
no modification of the foundation draft, released code, tests, results, README, CI, CITATION, PDFs, or manifests
no test or implementation file may exist before this plan commit is pushed
confirmatory conformance runs execute exactly once per plan version; the harness must recompute and verify this plan's canonical hash and refuse to overwrite completed results

quote_law.baseline_state: z = x + dt*u(x); frozen per-cell algebra, never a rollout
quote_law.cost_rule: C_a(q) >= 0, C_a(0) = 0, declared and committed pre-execution; no-double-count condition of Gate-1A review section E is normative (C_a prices the action process only, never a state-carried burden; monetary/labour and audit penalties excluded)
quote_law.epoch_rule: first model: no intra-tick reallocation after a rejection; any reallocation opens a new quote epoch invalidating all affected committed schedules (Gate-1A review section I)
quote_law.linear_diagnostic: de_lin(q) = dt*q*(mu_i(z_i) - eta*mu_j(z_j)) - C_a(q); diagnostic only, never settlement
quote_law.one_edge_form: de(q) = v_i(z_i) + v_j(z_j) - v_i(z_i - dt*q) - v_j(z_j + dt*eta*q) - C_a(q)
quote_law.overexecution_envelope: q_meas > q_acc: never positive credit; mandatory protocol-violation record; physical overdraw reported to the physical layer; any debit schedule must itself be precommitted; full semantics OPEN (O8)
quote_law.schedule_domain: [0, q_acc] with q_acc from P1C allocation
quote_law.settlement: exact finite-difference value at the measured point of the schedule committed before execution; no post-outcome valuation rule

random_checks.non_vacuous_rule: at least 50 percent of generated random cases per group must have q > 0 AND a nonzero exact quote magnitude > 1e-6; a group failing this is vacuous and FAILS (F12 guard)

prohibited_seeds_during_conformance.note: V2.6 layout seeds 0..11 appear ONLY inside the Q22 replay protocol, which is not conformance and runs only in a later authorized gate

ranges.q: uniform in [0, q_acc] with q_acc from declared feasibility caps

random_checks.status: random checks are numerical validation only, never proof

tolerances.byte_identity: exact float tuple equality for Q17 (no rounding)
tolerances.json_safety: allow_nan=false everywhere; non-finite in any quote, schedule, settlement, or violation field is a hard error
